startUrls.title: Websites or sitemap URLs
startUrls.description: A site home page (sitemaps are discovered from robots.txt, falling back to /sitemap.xml) or a direct sitemap / sitemap index URL.

maxUrls.title: Max URLs
maxUrls.description: Stop after this many URLs (across all sitemaps).

checkStatus.title: Check HTTP status of each URL
checkStatus.description: Sends one HEAD request per URL (2 per second) and reports status codes and redirect targets. Finds 404s and redirects listed in your sitemap.

sameOriginOnly.title: Only URLs on the sitemap's own domain
sameOriginOnly.description: Skip URLs whose domain differs from the sitemap file's domain.
